description: This PHP class represents a model for email configuration settings within the OrangeHRM administration plugin API. It defines serialization schema and handles an EmailConfiguration entity, including setting filters and attribute names for API responses.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing and normalizing email configuration data for the OrangeHRM admin API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an EmailConfiguration entity and sets property filters and attribute names for serialization.
